name: Graph
description: Plot mathematical functions and data on cartesian axes. Plots stay editable: they keep the expression, domain and axes, so changing sin(x) to sin(2x) re-computes the curve.

descriptionI18n.zh-TW: 在座標軸上畫數學函數與資料點。圖形保持可編輯：保留算式、定義域與座標軸，把 sin(x) 改成 sin(2x) 會重新計算曲線。

capabilities.title: Plot a function
capabilities.description: Plot y = f(x). Without a canvas a new blank canvas with axes is created. Reuses the canvas's axes when it has some; otherwise creates axes that fit the curve. Expressions use x, numbers, + - * / ^, implicit multiplication (2x, 3(x+1)), |x|, pi, e and functions such as sin cos tan sqrt abs exp ln log (base 10) floor min max.

expression.description: Right-hand side of y = ..., e.g. sin(x) or x^2 - 2x

domain.description: [xmin, xmax]; default the axes' x range

xRange.description: x range of NEW axes; default fits the domain (±2π for trigonometric functions, else ±10)

yRange.description: y range of NEW axes; default fits the curve

frame.description: id of the axes to draw on, when the canvas has several

label.description: Custom legend text; empty hides it

labelMode.description: auto follows the current expression; custom preserves label. Default custom when label is supplied, otherwise auto.

profile.whenToUse: Plot y = f(x) from a formula so the user can edit it later.
profile.whenNotToUse: Data without a formula, implicit curves, 3D or parametric plots.
profile.inputLimits: Expression up to 256 characters in x; one curve per call.

cost.resource: Calculated on this server; at most a few thousand evaluations.

reliability.note: Computed from the parsed expression by adaptive sampling; asymptotes are not joined.
reliability.verify: Look at the preview: the curve should match the formula at a few points.

fallbacks.then: Rewrite it with the supported functions (sin cos tan sqrt abs exp ln log floor min max) or plot sampled points with plot_points.

zh-TW.whenToUse: 用公式畫 y = f(x)，之後使用者可以再編輯。
zh-TW.whenNotToUse: 沒有公式的資料、隱函數、3D 或參數式曲線。
zh-TW.inputLimits: 算式最多 256 字元、變數 x；每次一條曲線。

cost.resource: 在這台伺服器計算，最多幾千次取樣。

dataFlow.sends: 沒有任何資料離開伺服器。

reliability.note: 依解析後的算式自適應取樣；漸近線不會被連起來。
reliability.verify: 看預覽圖：曲線在幾個點上應符合公式。

fallbacks.then: 改用支援的函數（sin cos tan sqrt abs exp ln log floor min max），或用 plot_points 畫取樣點。

capabilities.title: Change a plot
capabilities.description: Change an existing function plot: a new expression, domain, colour or label. The curve is re-computed; the object keeps its id.

object.description: id of the function plot, e.g. o2

labelMode.description: Set auto to resume formula labels; setting label alone selects custom.

capabilities.title: Set the axes
capabilities.description: Change the x/y range, grid, π ticks, title or axis labels of the canvas's axes (or create axes on a blank canvas). Every plot on them is redrawn.

object.description: id of the axes; default the canvas's axes

piTicks.description: Label the x axis in multiples of π
